report.verdict: A senior backend engineer whose payments and infrastructure work comes with scale and results.
write_up: Your resume makes a strong case for senior backend work! At Lumen Ledger, you show both the engineering behind the payments platform and the scale it handles. The earlier freight and insurance roles make the progression easy to follow.
The balance API line is a great model: it names the change you made and shows latency before and after. Your headline fits the work, and Experience is easy to find above Education.

Let’s add a little more about what maintaining the claims services involved. If you made a wider platform decision during the ledger migration, that could also show what you’re ready to take on next. Your resume is unlikely to be the reason you’re passed over; how competitive a role is will matter too.

cards.where: Senior Software Engineer, Payments Platform, line 3
cards.line: Cut p99 latency on the balance API from 900 ms to 140 ms by moving reads to a Kafka-fed cache
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. It connects a technical choice to a measurable improvement without making the reader guess what you did.

cards.line: Maintained the claims intake services in Java
cards.cannot_tell: Maintaining the services could cover several kinds of work. A concrete fix or improvement would show what you handled there.
cards.example: Maintained the claims intake services in Java by [maintenance work]
cards.question: What fix or improvement did you make to the claims intake services?

cards.where: Senior Software Engineer, Payments Platform, line 2
cards.line: Led the migration of the ledger from a single Postgres instance to a sharded cluster with zero downtime over six weekends
cards.cannot_tell: The migration already shows strong technical leadership. A wider platform decision, if you made one, could show how your work reached beyond the migration itself.
cards.example: Led the migration of the ledger from a single Postgres instance to a sharded cluster with zero downtime over six weekends; made [platform-wide decision]
cards.question: What platform-wide decision did you make in connection with the migration?

fit.why: Your headline and current role point to senior backend work, with payments services, a ledger migration and API performance improvements.
fit.level: senior, leads a ledger migration and mentors two mid-level engineers
fit.note: Your experience points toward backend platform and payments engineering roles. The Go, PostgreSQL and Kafka work gives a recruiter concrete technologies to match against a role.
